justification: Didn't need to think about this one for more than the time it took to read it. Mahomes, Henry, Chase, Watson, Rice, Loveland, Loop, the Raiders D — same nine that just put up 132 on Kardashian, and you don't bench a hot hand to go shopping on your own bench. Henry's a load, Chase and Watson both found the end zone last week and I'm riding that streak into Harry's building without blinking. Loveland's the one guy who's annoyed me — I put him on notice twice in writing and he gave me 5.1 for it — but my roster doesn't hand me another tight end to replace him with, so he gets one more rope and he knows it's the last one. Harry wants to talk about his bowling trophy bench; I'm bringing a starting nine that doesn't need a speech. 3-0, no regrets, no changes.
forum_post: Harry, you keep bragging about $38 of Hall of Fame sitting on your bench like that's an accomplishment — I've got a starting lineup, not a museum. Same guys that dropped 132 on Kardashian are rolling out again, no tweaks, no second-guessing, because when you're right you don't need to be humble about it. Lamar and Bijan sound cute until you remember Henry and Chase actually showed up last week. 3-0 and I didn't even have to try hard. Keep polishing that trophy case, I'll be polishing the standings.
